checks.name: package_metadata_ok
checks.title: Package metadata exposes vmem and legacy CLI
checks.message: pyproject package name and console scripts are correct
checks.impact: Users can invoke vMem from the installed wheel.
checks.fix: Set project.name=vmem and expose both vmem and memory-os console scripts.

checks.name: doctor_passes
checks.title: Doctor passes on a fresh writable memory dir
checks.message: vmem doctor reports all checks healthy

checks.name: hooks
checks.message: hook order ok: prompt_budget_guard before retriever

checks.name: retriever_pressure
checks.message: retriever fallback and daemon consume pressure state

checks.impact: Users get a single command that proves the installation is sane.
checks.fix: Run vmem repair, verify packaged hook files, and ensure MEMORY_OS_DIR is writable.

checks.name: install_repair_idempotent
checks.title: Install/repair are idempotent
checks.message: install writes the guard once and repair is a no-op
checks.impact: Users can safely re-run repair without duplicating hooks.
checks.fix: Normalize UserPromptSubmit hooks so prompt_budget_guard is first and unique.

checks.name: context_warn_overflow_enters_working_set
checks.title: Warning context overflow enters working-set mode
checks.message: warn watermark triggers bounded working-set reclaim before hard overflow
checks.impact: vMem starts OS-style working-set reclaim at the warning watermark, before requests reach the API context-window failure point.
checks.fix: Make prompt_budget_guard write working_set state, shed optional context, and emit only bounded recovery context under warning pressure.

checks.name: high_pressure_sheds_retriever
checks.title: High pressure sheds optional retrieval context
checks.message: fallback emits no additionalContext and daemon is wired before Stage 0
checks.impact: This is the local proof that vMem prevents extra context from pushing requests toward API 400.
checks.fix: Ensure retriever.py and retriever_daemon.py call should_shed_optional_context before retrieval/injection.

checks.name: fault_no_db_degrades
checks.title: No store.db degrades instead of crashing
checks.message: production assertions return shaped DEGRADED report without store.db
checks.impact: Fresh installs and broken stores produce actionable diagnostics rather than stack traces.
checks.fix: Return a normal report shape for no-db and keep text/json modes tolerant.

checks.name: public_hygiene_passes
checks.title: Public files contain no internal strings
checks.impact: Public releases do not leak internal organization references.
checks.fix: Remove internal strings from public docs/configs or construct scanner patterns dynamically.
